text: Fixing #6583/#6585/#6586/#6587 (COPY FILE, RENAME), stacked on the ERASE PR #6702 for its shared helpers: real VFP9 shows bare tokens are literal filenames and (expr) evaluates, and source wildcards expand and MAP into the destination (*.bin TO *.bak -> one.bak; ?ne.bin TO ?ne.bak maps the ?; directory destination receives copies; fixed destination: COPY FILE last wins, RENAME second fails with error 7); unlike ERASE, missing source / no-match is error 1. Fail-first: 34 failures before, 0 after across 21 exact-content cases. Not replicated: VFP lower-casing bare names and its .dbf default for an extensionless bare RENAME name.
